# FlagRisk

> FlagRisk is a community safety network built for Africa, starting in Nigeria. It keeps you and the people you trust one tap apart, so help is never a stranger. You raise an alarm to reach your circle instantly, share a trip with Trip Watch so they can follow you from the first step to the front door, and check the live risk map to know your area before you set out. It works across a mobile app, WhatsApp, SMS and USSD, so it reaches both smartphones and feature phones.

FlagRisk is operated by FlagRisk Technologies Limited (RC 9690636), registered at 325 Enugu Road, FCDA Quarters, Bwari, Abuja, Nigeria. General enquiries, support and data requests: hello@flagrisk.org. The rollout is national across Nigeria as of October 2026.

## What FlagRisk does

- Raise an alarm: one tap reaches the people you trust, with your location, so the first responders are the people who love you.
- Trip Watch: share a journey and your circle follows along until you arrive; if you stop or go quiet, they know.
- Know your area: a live risk map shows safety concerns nearby so you can choose a safer route home.
- Your circle: add up to seven trusted people who can reach you and be reached when it matters.
- Channels: the app, WhatsApp, SMS and USSD, so it works on any phone, with or without data.
- Language: FlagRisk speaks in terms of "safety concerns", not alarmist "danger".

## Plans (Nigerian Naira, billed monthly)

- Basic: free forever. 5 km alert radius, 7 days of history, up to 7 in your circle.
- Standard: NGN 700 per month. 15 km alert radius, 30 days of history.
- Pro: NGN 1,300 per month. 50 km alert radius, 90 days of history.
- Premium: NGN 2,500 per month. 500 km alert radius, 180 days of history, priority verification.

Safety basics are always free. Paid plans only widen how far your people can reach you and how long your history is kept. Paid plans are purchased securely through Paystack on WhatsApp or the web, never inside the app, and can be changed or cancelled anytime.
